description: Create standard fillable AcroForm fields in an existing PDF at exact positions, or (detect true) find them on a flat PDF yourself: text, multiline text, checkbox, radio group, dropdown and signature box. Coordinates are PDF points measured from the bottom-left corner of the page as the viewer sees it (1 inch = 72 pt; US Letter is 612 x 792), the same frame and 1-based page numbers as pdf_edit; x and y are the field's bottom-left corner and the whole rectangle must lie inside the page (each side at least 4 pt). Every entry needs type, name and page; every type except radio also needs x, y, width and height; radio and dropdown need options. Unknown keys are rejected. A radio entry is one group whose options each carry their own value, x, y, width and height. name is 1-200 characters with no dot, unique in the request and not already a field name in the PDF (a name that equals the first part of an existing dotted name is also taken). Text takes multiline, max_length, default and font_size; checkbox takes checked; dropdown takes options (strings), default and font_size. All entries also take required, read_only, border (default true) and background (default false). font_size is a number from 1 to 200 or "auto". If omitted, text, multiline text and dropdown fields get a fixed size of min(12 pt, the largest size at which one line fits the field height), at least 4 pt, so they draw predictably when filled; a value longer than the box is then clipped, not shrunk. "auto" stores size 0, and pdf_fill then sizes the text to the box when the blank field is first filled (a short value is enlarged, a long one shrunk) and keeps that size, so a later, longer value is clipped: for predictable text omit font_size or set a number. Defaults and dropdown options use standard fonts (WinAnsi characters only: euro sign and curly quotes work, Polish L-stroke and CJK fail). The signature type creates an EMPTY signature field for a signing tool to use: nothing is signed, it is not an e-signature. At most 200 entries and 200 widgets per call, and 2,000 fields in the finished form. Fields are plain AcroForm with no JavaScript. Fill the result with pdf_fill (pdf_inspect lists the new fields). For a flat PDF with no fillable fields, either call pdf_detect_fields first, review the suggestions and pass the ones you keep as fields, or set detect true instead of fields to detect and add in one call (text and checkbox fields only, from blanks drawn as lines, boxes, underscores and checkboxes, in one request; pages, max_pages and min_confidence apply as in pdf_detect_fields; detect cannot be combined with fields; the answer reports how many fields were added, and review is easier with pdf_detect_fields first). Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource; the source is never modified.

detect.description: Instead of fields: detect the blanks drawn on a flat PDF and add a text or checkbox field for each (the engine of pdf_detect_fields). Cannot be combined with fields. Default false.

fields.description: Fields to create. Required unless detect is true. Nothing is added unless every entry is valid. Required keys: every entry type, name, page; text, checkbox, dropdown and signature also x, y, width, height; radio and dropdown also options (radio options carry their own rectangles).

background.description: Paint an opaque white background. Default false (none).

border.description: Draw a black 1 pt outline. Default true.

checked.description: Checkbox only: start ticked. Default false.

confidence.description: Ignored. Lets an entry from pdf_detect_fields be passed as it is.

default.description: Text, radio (one option value) or dropdown (one option): the starting value.

font_size.description: Text and dropdown: points (1-200), or "auto" (size chosen at the first fill, then kept). Omitted: a fixed min(12, largest size that fits one line in the height), at least 4.

height.description: Height in points. Not used by radio.

label.description: Ignored. Lets an entry from pdf_detect_fields be passed as it is.

multiline.description: Text only: allow several lines. Default false.

name.description: Field name: no dot, unique, not already in the PDF.

options.description: Dropdown: strings. Radio: objects with value, x, y, width and height.

value.description: Option value, unique in the group, not "Off".

read_only.description: Set the field's ReadOnly flag. Default false.

required.description: Set the field's Required flag. Default false.

width.description: Width in points. Not used by radio.

x.description: Left edge in points from the page's left. Not used by radio.

y.description: Bottom edge in points from the page's bottom. Not used by radio.

max_pages.description: With detect: analyse at most this many pages. Default 40.

min_confidence.description: With detect: drop fields below this confidence. Default 0.4.

pages.description: With detect: pages to analyse, "1-3,5,8-". Default all.

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

name: pdf_add_fields

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

detect_truncated.description: With detect: the answer is incomplete (more than 200 fields, more than max_pages pages, or the call stopped at its limit); send the returned PDF again with detect true and pages set to next_pages; repeat until this is absent

fields_detected.description: With detect: how many fields were detected and added (0 leaves the PDF unchanged)

next_pages.description: With detect: pages not done (page spec, including a page cut at 200 fields); send the returned PDF again with detect true and pages set to it

note.description: With detect and no fields found

pages_skipped.description: With detect: pages not analysed because they hold more drawn shapes or text than the per-page limits

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

warning.description: Present as xfa-layer-dropped when a hybrid AcroForm/XFA input lost its XFA layer

title: Add fillable form fields to a PDF
